description:
§24.5: a declaration whose renders root is an HTML breakout element () is E-HTML-FOREIGN-BREAKOUT where it is USED inside

is fine.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S474 "⭐ RULED — FORK RULE row C amended: semantic impossibility may be PERMANENT" (the PERMANENT class); the code and its reading are a PA reading in the S474 review of #1727 (F2, c_spanInSvg: the page failed to mount in Chromium)
rationale: §24.5 item 1: "The same holds for a declaration's renders where the declaration is used in such a position. That fault is reported at the use, because the renders are inserted, and parsed, in the use's context."
